change: Start each seed from its hash-locked R19 checkpoint, restart optimizer, run 8 epochs at 10% of R19 learning rates. Keep loss and input unchanged and include untouched epoch 0 as a candidate under the R25 joint checkpoint rule.
checkpoint_selection: Among epochs with raw MAE <= 102% and Acc2 >= baseline minus .005 versus the corresponding R19 seed, maximize the smaller of F1 and Acc3 improvements over the R19 three-seed means, then mean improvement, then lower raw MAE. If no eligible epoch exists, use minimum raw MAE. Fixed 8-epoch budget; include epoch 0. Candidates with exactly tied ranks retain the earlier epoch.
pass: F1 and Acc3 each +0.5 percentage points or more; Acc2 loses at most 0.5 percentage points; raw MAE <= 102% of R19.
rationale: R25 Acc3 gained 0.513 pp but F1 gained only 0.247 pp and raw MAE rose 2.085%. Two seeds exceeded their seed-matched MAE guards. Test whether local fine-tuning around verified R19 weights instead of retraining makes the joint checkpoint selection more stable.
